title: Last Breathes
description: Automatically records and saves the last 10 seconds of gameplay as a video when you die. Never miss your most epic death moments!
body:
🎬 Last Breathes

Never miss your most epic death moments!

Developed by Markesr

Last Breathes is a Minecraft client-side mod that automatically records the last moments of your gameplay and allows you to save them as a video file right from the Death Screen.

🌟 Features

  • Auto-Recording: Continuously buffers the last few seconds of your gameplay in memory without saving to your disk until you decide to!
  • Zero Lag: Optimized with multi-threading, Ring Buffers, and OpenGL PBOs to ensure it has virtually no impact on your FPS.
  • Save on Death: When you die, a new "Save Last Breathes" button appears on the death screen. Click it, and your final moments will be instantly exported as a video!
  • Highly Configurable: Change the video length, resolution scale, FPS, and more via ModMenu.

⚙️ Requirements

  • Fabric API
  • Cloth Config API (Required for settings)
  • ModMenu (Highly recommended for configuring the mod)

🎮 How to Use

  1. Install the mod and its dependencies.
  2. Play the game normally! The mod will silently record your gameplay in the background.
  3. When you die, click the "🎬 Save Last Breathes" button on the death screen.
  4. The video will be saved in your Minecraft last_breathes directory.
